patches.name: Subtitle translation
patches.description: Translates the subtitles of the videos you play into a language you choose, including subtitles embedded in the video file. The on/off switch and the target language live in the kyurem39's patches settings panel.

patches.name: Vietnamese interface
patches.description: Translates the application interface into Vietnamese.
